newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MAY COMMERCIAL BANK ASSETS 27.6 BLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: MAY COMMERCIAL BANK ASSETS 27.6 BLN KROONS.

text.p: The combined assets of Estonian commercial banks increased by 8.6 percent in May to 27.8 billion kroons from April's 25.6 billion kroons, the central bank said on Friday.
The total profit of the banking sector reached 415.3 million kroons from April's 329.4 million kroons, the bank said in a statement.
Total deposits increased from 16 billion kroons to 17.2 billion kroons in May.
Total loans and claims by the banks on their customers increased to 15.3 billion kroons from 14.1 billion kroons.
Total loans to the government sector increased to 384.9 million kroons from 248.7 million kroons.
